### workspace alfred --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace alfred <subcommand>

Subcommands:
  install     Install or update the Alfred workflow
  uninstall   Remove the Alfred workflow
  info        Show workflow installation status

The workflow lets you type 'wf' in Alfred to list and focus
active workspace projects. Assign a hotkey in Alfred Preferences
> Workflows > Workspace Focus.

Examples:
  workspace alfred install    # install or update the Alfred workflow
  workspace alfred info    # show the workflow's installation status
  workspace alfred uninstall    # remove the Alfred workflow
--- stderr
--- end

### workspace alfred install --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace alfred install

Install or update the Alfred workflow for workspace focus.
Copies workflow files to Alfred's preferences directory.

Examples:
  workspace alfred install    # add the 'wf' workflow to Alfred, or update it after upgrading workspace
  workspace alfred install && workspace alfred info    # install, then confirm where it went
  workspace alfred install | grep Installed    # print the line saying where it was installed
--- stderr
--- end

--- stdout

--- stderr
--- end
### workspace alfred uninstall --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace alfred uninstall

Remove the Alfred workflow for workspace focus. Asks for a y/N
confirmation before deleting; nothing is removed if the workflow is
not installed.

Examples:
  workspace alfred uninstall    # remove the workflow from Alfred, after confirming
  workspace alfred uninstall </dev/null    # answer nothing: it cancels and removes nothing
  WORKSPACE_NO_INPUT=1 workspace alfred uninstall    # in an unattended script with the workflow installed: exits 1 with an error instead of waiting
--- stderr
--- end

--- stdout

### workspace alfred info --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace alfred info

Show the installation status of the Alfred workflow.

Examples:
  workspace alfred info    # see whether the workflow is installed, and where
  workspace alfred info | grep -q 'is installed' || workspace alfred install    # install it only when missing
  workspace alfred info | grep Location    # find the workflow's folder to edit it by hand
--- stderr
--- end
